privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body:
Other users only see your animal.colour name, age band and gender: never your email, exact age, location or contacts.

Venue turnout is always shown in bands and statistics appear only with at least 3 people.

Location is optional, rounded to about 500 m, used only while the app is open and deleted after 3 hours. Contacts are optional: we only send encrypted codes of phone numbers, deleted right after matching.

Chats are deleted 2 days after the night, photos 7 days after posting. Where you go and what you post is visible only to followers you accepted.

We don't sell data and use no advertising SDKs. You can delete your account at any time from your profile.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.body:
RightPlace is for adults only.

Offensive, violent, sexual or illegal content and harassment are not tolerated: reported content is removed within 24 hours and responsible accounts are suspended.

You can report content and block users at any time.
